response.overview: Five years have passed since the completion of my previous work, "cutout." "cutout2" was created using the same methods as "cutout," but because the range of fieldwork was similar, I had fewer opportunities to encounter interesting filming locations. It seems that when there is a lack of stimulation for one's sensibilities, the speed of work production also slows down. During the production of this work, a collaboration with Qrion was established and "Ice Palace" was created, so the video materials used in "cutout2" overlap with those in "Ice Palace." Please understand.
response.title: cutout2
